wargear.name: The Talisman of Burning Blood
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic wargear and any attached unit gain +3" to their Movement (M) characteristic.

wargear.name: Brass Collar of Borghaster
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. When a model equipped with this Relic is targeted by a Psychic Power or Psychic Weapon, roll a D6. On a 4+ the Psyker targeting this unit suffers a Perils of the Warp.

wargear.name: The Armour of Khorne
wargear.datasheet: Angron, Daemon Primarch of the World Eaters
wargear.text: This wargear confers a 2+ Armour save. The unit equipped with this Armour cannot be targeted by Psychic Power or Psychic Weapons.
